about.title: Corporate Structure
about.subtitle: Comprehensive backing combining proprietary technology, strategic control tower operations, and private fleet assets across the United States and Mexico.
about.map_desc: Elastic capacity to coordinate over 1,000 active units across extended cross-border routes without operational interruption.
about.brokerage_desc: Strategic freight coordination and control tower based in the U.S. (Core hub of the 5PL operational model).
about.transportation_desc: FMCSA certified U.S. carrier located in Santa Teresa, NM. Assets: 50+ tractors, 100+ dry vans, flatbeds, and roadside service units.
about.logistics_desc: CTPAT certified Mexican carrier located in Cd. Juárez, CHIH. Assets: 150+ tractors, 250+ dry vans, 250+ reefers, private secure yard, and maintenance units.
about.about_warhorse_text: Warhorse is a premier trinational asset-based transportation and logistics enterprise. Bridging the United States, Mexico, and Canada, we deliver unmatched cross-border velocity, institutional integrity, and modern fleet reliability across critical trade corridors.
about.mission_text: To empower North American enterprise supply chains through relentless operational excellence, proactive safety compliance, cutting-edge telematics, and personalized logistics engineering.
about.values_text: We honor our commitments with complete operational transparency, strict ethical standards, and unwavering dedication to the drivers and cargo that move global commerce forward.
about.structure_subtitle: Three specialized entities operating under a unified standard of excellence.
about.scope_text: Integrated equipment versatility configured to match your manufacturing and freight specifications:
about.scope_dryvan_desc: Clean, air-ride enclosed trailers for manufacturing, automotive, and retail cargo.
about.scope_flatbed_desc: Open-deck heavy transport for steel, industrial machinery, and oversized freight.
about.scope_reefer_desc: Continuous digital cold-chain monitoring for pharmaceuticals, perishables, and temperature-sensitive freight.
about.scope_specialized_desc: Dual-driver expedited teams, customs bonded transit, and secure cross-border transfer.
about.fleet_us_desc: Interstate fleet domiciled in El Paso, TX and Santa Teresa, NM.
about.fleet_mx_desc: Dedicated cross-border drayage, transfers, and national tractors in Cd. Juárez, CHIH.
about.fleet_net_desc: Vetted and qualified carrier capacity across USA, Mexico & Canada.

security.title: Security &
security.subtitle: Rigorous security protocols engineered to safeguard your freight across every cross-border corridor.
security.infrastructure: 24/7 perimeter surveillance, biometric terminal access controls, and armed yard monitoring.
security.human_capital: Exhaustive background checks, polygraphs, and continuous HazMat and defensive driving certifications.
security.monitoring: ISO 17712 security seals, satellite telematics, automated route geofencing, and immediate panic alerts.
security.k9: Specialized K9 detection units deployed at private terminals and pre-departure inspection points.
security.inspection_desc: Rigorous pre-departure mechanical and structural inspection ensuring zero downtime and complete freight integrity.
security.ctpat_intro_title: CTPAT Tier Certification & Bilateral Security Shield
security.ctpat_intro_text: As a certified CTPAT partner collaborating directly with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and Mexican customs authorities, Warhorse implements exhaustive multi-layer security protocols. Every driver, tractor, trailer, and terminal operates under verifiable, auditable chain-of-custody standards.

points_11.title: 17-Point CTPAT Vehicle & Trailer Inspection
points_11.desc: Mandatory physical and mechanical verification covering bumper, engine, tires, floor, ceiling, fifth wheel, and undercarriage before every border dispatch.

points_11.title: ISO 17712 High-Security Bolt Seals
points_11.desc: Numbered, tamper-evident high-security seals verified, recorded, and audited at point of origin, customs crossing, and final delivery.

points_11.title: 24/7 Satellite GPS & Route Telematics
points_11.desc: Continuous real-time asset tracking powered by Samsara with automated alerts for unauthorized door openings or stops.

points_11.title: Vetted Drivers & Drug Screening
points_11.desc: 10-year employment history audits, criminal record background checks, biometric validation, and strict random drug screening.

points_11.title: Geo-Fenced Border Corridors
points_11.desc: Enforced approved transit corridors with pre-designated safe rest zones; immediate dispatch alarms upon route deviation.

points_11.title: Terminal Physical Security & CCTV
points_11.desc: Fully fenced, well-lit yards equipped with 24/7 high-definition recorded CCTV coverage and guard checkpoints.

points_11.title: Dual-Sign Off Seal Protocols
points_11.desc: Dual verification sign-off between security guards and operators with photographic evidence logged in digital archives.

points_11.title: Emergency Rapid Response Readiness
points_11.desc: Direct emergency escalation bridges with federal highway authorities and bilateral law enforcement agencies.

points_11.title: CBP FAST Lane Certification
points_11.desc: Qualification for Free and Secure Trade (FAST) expedited customs processing lanes at major international border crossings.

points_11.title: Bilateral Regulatory Safety Compliance
points_11.desc: 100% adherence to FMCSA (US DOT) safety regulations and Mexican Secretaría de Infraestructura, Comunicaciones y Transportes (SCT).

points_11.title: Biometric & Electronic Access Control
points_11.desc: Electronic logging and biometric security locks preventing unauthorized access to cabs, terminals, and operational hubs.
